scope: At each checkpoint only already-submitted jobs are loaded. Cached and fresh queries use the observed live state. Prediction replay replaces all unfinished durations and running completion events with time-limit estimates, excludes future submissions, and is compared against an independent actual continuation. Actual durations only establish observed past state and ground truth.
exact_caveat: Side query times include input-state sanitization and the existing exact API call; this currently entails two checkpoint clones. The native exact API itself replays the durations in its input state and does not enforce this information boundary automatically.
